page.layout: One block of text in one column; a catchword-like mark "tam" at the lower right is the start of the next line, not a separate block; a small mark "*" below the text is a signature-like reference mark. No margin notes. Running head at top with page number at left.

main_text.l: Christi & Spiritus Sancti Oves ejus regens
ac ducens, non magis hic eas destituet,
quàm alibi; prout singula ad salutem
nostram, ac Dei gloriam, conducunt. Ea-
dem unctio docet vos de omnibus; 1 Joh. 2, 27.
XXVI. Si quis dicat; Quòd nec at-
tentionem suam semper homo habeat in
potestate; nec efficere possit, ut ad libitum
sibi occurrant quæ oblectare eum
possint in Domino; neque Spiritum &
zelum sibi, cùm vult, impertiri; neque
facere ut Spiritus, qui ubi vult spirat, sibi
perpetuò præsto sit, & soletur infirmitates
suas. Ut multò tutiùs hæc exploratio
sui, cujusque fidelis judicio, arbitrio, &
libertati, committatur; ut qui solus scire
possit, quid hîc valeant humeri, quid
ferre recusent. Nam idem pensum
omnibus injungere, & citra discrimen
omnes sub eandem regulam cogere, &
eandem animi contentionem in hisce ex-
ercitiis promiscuè exigere, quid aliud fo-
ret; quàm omne inter infantes, adul-
tos, & perfectos, discrimen tollere; &
desperatione faciendi mandatum, occul-
tam
* [illegible, ~2 letters]

page.notes: The running head and page number are read from the top line. The first line of the page continues an earlier paragraph. The mark "*" below the text is a faint reference mark with no clear counterpart. The heading XXVI. is set as a paragraph opener within the text and is reproduced as a level 2 heading; some words near the top line are faint.
